acceptanceCriteria: Identify the exact corvint-tasks invocation (argv, cwd, parent, binary path/version) and the child or code path whose file access macOS attributed to corvint-tasks when the Music-folder privacy prompt appeared.

Either remove the access (no Corvint Tasks command or spawned child walks or opens paths under the user's home media folders unless the operator pointed it there) or document why the access is required, with a focused regression check.
Retain the observation as a suspected defect until the cause is reproduced; record NOT_OBSERVED where macOS TCC logs were unavailable.
body: Suspected defect, not yet reproduced. On 2026-10-08 about 12:00 UTC the owner reported a macOS privacy prompt asking to allow corvint-tasks to access the Music folder (owner wording: 'why is corvint-task asking for permisson t to my music'). At that time the orchestrating Claude Code session had run read-only corvint-tasks ticket show/search/receipt audit and four ticket grant-approval mutations from /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint, and five agent lanes plus a dogfood bind were running go test for internal/tasks packages in /private/tmp/claude-501 worktrees. Installed binary /Users/russelllewis/.local/bin/corvint-tasks, version 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202, go1.27.1. No corvint-tasks process was running when checked afterwards; no launchd agent. Source search of internal/tasks found no UserHomeDir use or home-directory walk (only HOME passed through to child environments in store/program_run.go and store/workflow.go). tccd and com.apple.TCC unified-log queries returned nothing from the agent shell (NOT_OBSERVED). Hypotheses: TCC responsibility attribution of a spawned child (git, go, host agent, test) to corvint-tasks; a test-built corvint-tasks binary run with a home-relative cwd or root; or a path probe reaching ~/Music. Expected: Corvint Tasks never touches home media folders unprompted. Actual: privacy prompt naming corvint-tasks.
title: Investigate macOS Music-folder privacy prompt attributed to corvint-tasks
